title: Potato annotation tool – 'Simple Single-Choice Example' (simple-radio-selection config)

author.name: davidjurgens
author.field: NLP / data annotation (any field that needs human labels on text, audio, images or video)

provenance.origin: github.com/davidjurgens/potato at ab18c251b066, personal (personal: "behavior tracking" "dashboard" in:readme,description archived:false (page 1))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Registered annotators work through a queue of text items and give each one a single-choice label from a scheme set in YAML. Each person's answers are saved separately, so labels can later be exported and compared across annotators. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
